description: Fungal ortholog conservation of LEE1 CCCH finger positions, compared with the TIS11d RNA-contact weights
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}

# ---- UniRef50 cluster containing Q02799 -> fungal orthologs ----
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/search",
   params={"query":"uniprot_id:Q02799 AND identity:0.5","fields":"id,name,count","format":"tsv"},headers=H,timeout=90)
print(r.text)
cid=r.text.strip().split("\n")[1].split("\t")[0]
mem=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/{cid}/members",
   params={"format":"json","size":500},headers=H,timeout=120).json()
rows=[]
for m in mem.get("results",[]):
    rows.append((m.get("memberId"),m.get("organismName"),m.get("sequence",{}).get("value","")))
print("cluster",cid,"members fetched:",len(rows))

pat=re.compile(r'C.{4,15}?C.{3,8}?C.{3,4}?H')
def fingers(seq):
    out=[];pos=0
    while True:
        m=pat.search(seq,pos)
        if not m: break
        mm=re.match(r'C(.{4,15}?)C(.{3,8}?)C(.{3,4}?)H',m.group(0))
        out.append(dict(start=m.start()+1,end=m.end(),sp=(len(mm.group(1)),len(mm.group(2)),len(mm.group(3))),motif=m.group(0)))
        pos=m.end()
    return out

POS1=['C1','C1+1','C1+2','C1+3','C1+4','C1+5','C1+6','C1+7','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C2+3','C2+4','C2+5','C3','C3+1','C3+2','C3+3','H']
def anchor_str(f):   # only for C-x7-C-x5-C-x3-H fingers
    return list(f['motif']) if f['sp']==(7,5,3) else None

z1=[];z2=[];orgs=[];lead1=[];lead2=[]
for mid,org,seq in rows:
    if not seq: continue
    fs=[f for f in fingers(seq)]
    # take the first adjacent pair with linker <=25
    pair=None
    for i in range(len(fs)-1):
        if fs[i+1]['start']-fs[i]['end']-1<=25: pair=(fs[i],fs[i+1]); break
    if not pair: continue
    a,b=pair
    sa,sb=anchor_str(a),anchor_str(b)
    if sa and sb:
        z1.append(sa); z2.append(sb); orgs.append(org)
        lead1.append(seq[max(0,a['start']-7):a['start']-1]); lead2.append(seq[max(0,b['start']-7):b['start']-1])
print("orthologs with a C-x7-C-x5-C-x3-H tandem pair:",len(z1))
print("organisms (first 25):",orgs[:25])

def consensus(mat,labels):
    df=pd.DataFrame(mat,columns=labels)
    out=[]
    for c in labels:
        cnt=Counter(df[c]); tot=sum(cnt.values()); top,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        out.append(dict(pos=c,consensus=top,freq=round(n/tot,3),LEE1=None,
                        alt=",".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k,v in cnt.most_common(4))))
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

lee1_z1=list("CKFFKMGNCQAGSSCPFSH"); lee1_z2=list("CKYFAKGNCKFGNKCVNAH")
c1=consensus(z1,POS1); c1['LEE1']=lee1_z1
c2=consensus(z2,POS1); c2['LEE1']=lee1_z2
# TIS11d-equivalent RNA contact weights (from 1RGO, computed earlier)
Wmap={'C1':2.0,'C1+1':11.0,'C1+2':1.5,'C2':0.0,'C2+1':3.5,'C2+2':36.0,'C2+3':0.0,'C2+4':0.0,'C2+5':8.5,
      'C3':4.5,'C3+1':18.0,'C3+2':60.0,'C3+3':0.0,'H':0.0}
for d in (c1,c2): d['TIS11d_contacts']=d.pos.map(lambda p:Wmap.get(p,0.0))
print("\n=== LEE1 ZF1: fungal ortholog conservation vs TIS11d RNA-contact weight ===")
print(c1.to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== LEE1 ZF2 ===")
print(c2.to_string(index=False))
c1.to_csv('lee1_zf1_ortholog_conservation.csv',index=False); c2.to_csv('lee1_zf2_ortholog_conservation.csv',index=False)

# linker length distribution across orthologs
links=[]
for mid,org,seq in rows:
    if not seq: continue
    fs=fingers(seq)
    for i in range(len(fs)-1):
        L=fs[i+1]['start']-fs[i]['end']-1
        if L<=25 and fs[i]['sp']==(7,5,3) and fs[i+1]['sp']==(7,5,3): links.append(L); break
print("\ninter-finger linker across orthologs: n=%d  median=%.1f  range=%d-%d"%(len(links),np.median(links),min(links),max(links)))
print(Counter(links).most_common())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,4.6))
for i,(d,t) in enumerate([(c1,'LEE1 finger 1'),(c2,'LEE1 finger 2')]):
    x=np.arange(len(d))
    ax[i].bar(x,d.freq,color=['#1864ab' if p in ('C1','C2','C3','H') else ('#c92a2a' if w>=18 else '#adb5bd') for p,w in zip(d.pos,d.TIS11d_contacts)])
    ax[i].set_xticks(x); ax[i].set_xticklabels([f"{p}\n{l}" for p,l in zip(d.pos,d.LEE1)],fontsize=8)
    ax[i].set_ylim(0,1.05); ax[i].set_ylabel("fraction of %d fungal orthologs\nsharing the LEE1-consensus residue"%len(z1))
    ax[i].set_title(t+"  (blue = Zn ligand, red = high RNA-contact position in TIS11d)",fontsize=9)
plt.suptitle("Conservation of LEE1 CCCH finger positions across fungal orthologs (UniRef50 %s)"%cid,fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
